Long sentence  For High end customers, we found they are booking the hotel through their agent, while the pre-arrival needs are fragmented and even remain unsaid. So we designed a new service blueprint to discover the unsaid and manage them easily. It moves the heavy effort in online booking for agent and offline observing for hotel, and we would know it failed if hotels still need substantial manual follow-up to understand guests’ needs.
Headline  Surface the unsaid, manage with ease.
Once upon a time, in the heart of Hong Kong, there was an ultra-luxury hotel called Mandarin Oriental, where every detail was designed to deliver an exceptional guest experience.
The hotel manager and staffs work tirelessly to receive , anticipate and fulfill customers’ needs, and trying to make every stay memorable.
The guest arrived and found his needs never fulfilled. The stay felt ordinary, leaving them disappointed with both the hotel and the agent.
the hotel did a review and found out that the preference of the guest was not mentioned in the booking online. Some of their preferences had never reached the hotel.
The boss felt the stay was ordinary and nothing really stood out. The pre-arrival process had never surfaced the preferences that could have made the stay feel more personal.

the hotel consulted with us, and we helped them design connected service journey where the agent shares known needs during booking, and the Dream Maker discovers additional preferences through natural interactions on arrival. Together, they help hotel teams turn these details into thoughtful responses throughout the stay.

Mandarin Oriental is now able to surface all the unsaid preference from the guests, manage with ease and elevate their stay, beating Rosewood, Four Seasons,  Ritz-Carlton . . . to become the best hotel in HK.

For hotel guests whose stays are booked through agents, we found that some personal preferences may not reach the hotel, so we designed a connected service journey from booking to arrival to turn emerging preferences into thoughtful surprises; it aims to strengthen guests’ sense of being understood, and we will know it failed if information is lost between handovers or guests feel no more recognised than with standard service.
Connecting booking to stay, turning guest potential needs  into thoughtful surprises.

For MO high-net-worth guests, 

we found they usually book through agents, making it hard for hotels to reach them directly before arrival to understand their true needs and offer personalized services, 

so we designed a new service process to help hotels gather guest preferences through agents during the booking stage. 

It moves repeat booking rates and brand loyalty, 

and we will know it failed if travel agents refuse to share guest details though this way or guests find the process intrusive.
Connecting agent insights and Dream Maker relationships to help MO understand and serve guests.

下一页有点难，是关于user journey map的slide。其实我们是想说，用户在给酒店服务评价的时候，实际上是走一个checklist，从预定开始，收到确认函，酒店接机，到酒店，帮忙提行李，welcome，check in，工作人员领路到房间，进入房间，体验房间的第1min，这之中的各个环节都是他的checklist，每一项checklist都会打分来看服务到不到位，自己是不是满意，直到最后体验房间的一分钟，是对pre-arrival customization最大的一个checklist。
即，前面的checklist都不错，最后这个体验房间的1min，如果做好的话，就是满意度大幅度上升；如果前面有checklist掉链子，那最后满意度也不会很大的改变。这就说明了所有的环节都很重要，是用户被感觉认知到的基础，然后最后房间体验的1min，一些touching point让他记住自己被recognized了。证明我们one share intent是重要且符合用户感知的。
